verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships a documented MCP server and CLI (`pscale sql`, secure shell) that let agents run SQL and access database info/tools, and its self-improving-database workflow has agents propose changes via pull requests rather than direct destructive writes, implying some safety-by-design. However, there's no explicit documentation of tool-level scoping that labels or separates read-only versus destructive/write operations within the MCP tool set or CLI. missing for 10: explicit docs on read-only vs write/destructive tool permissions, granular scoping/allowlisting for agents, independent confirmation that destructive actions require distinct authorization.
